text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace breezes through her debut 
race! However, this is only the starting 
line. She readies herself anew to become 
the "Ace" of the Umamusume world.

The Trainer suggested taking the Classic 
Triple Crown route. If she could conquer 
this formidable wall, it would prove that 
no "other world" existed.

Her peer Mr. C.B. is also soon to make her 
debut. Her skill is so great that once she 
starts running, Katsuragi Ace would be 
left behind.

Mr. C.B.'s back is still far ahead. She 
would embark on a training journey and 
catch up no matter what. Katsuragi Ace 
made that firm resolve!
